# Astroicons

> Astroicons is an open-source (MIT) set of SVG icons for astronomical and astrological symbols: planets, zodiac signs, aspects, angles, houses, nodes, asteroids and lots. Icons are distributed as raw SVG files and as React components through the `@astroicons/react` package.

All icons are drawn on a 24×24 grid, use `fill="none"`, `stroke="currentColor"` and a `1px` stroke by default, so they inherit the surrounding text color.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcmarine/astroicons/main/README.md): Project overview, installation, usage and props
- [@astroicons/react README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcmarine/astroicons/main/packages/react/README.md): React package documentation
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcmarine/astroicons/main/packages/react/CHANGELOG.md): Release history of `@astroicons/react`
- [Icon browser](https://astroicons.com): Search, preview, customize and download every icon

## React usage

Install:

```bash
npm install @astroicons/react
```

Requires `react >= 18`.

Import icons individually (tree-shakeable, recommended):

```tsx
import { Sun, Conjunction, Moon } from '@astroicons/react'

export function Chart() {
  return (
    <>
      <Sun />
      <Conjunction size={16} />
      <Moon color="tomato" strokeWidth={1.5} />
    </>
  )
}
```

A single icon can also be imported from its own entry point: `import Sun from '@astroicons/react/icons/sun'`.

Render an icon dynamically by name (loads the full registry; use only when the name is resolved at runtime):

```tsx
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@astroicons/react/icon'

export function Symbol({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
  return <Icon name={name} />
}
```

`Icon` renders `null` (and warns outside production) when the name is not in the registry.

### Props

Every icon component forwards its `ref` to the `<svg>` element and accepts:

| Prop          | Type                           | Default          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `size`        | `string \| number`             | `24`             |
| `color`       | `string`                       | `'currentColor'` |
| `strokeWidth` | `string \| number`             | `1`              |
| `className`   | `string`                       | —                |
| `...rest`     | `SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement>` | —                |

`size` sets both `width` and `height`; `color` sets the `stroke`.

### Exports

- `@astroicons/react`: one named PascalCase component per icon, plus `createIcon` and the types `IconProps`, `IconNode`
- `@astroicons/react/icon`: the `Icon` component and the `IconName` union type
- `@astroicons/react/icons/<icon-name>`: default export of a single icon

## Icons

Icon names are kebab-case (used for SVG file names, `IconName` and `/icons/<name>` imports). React component names are the PascalCase form (e.g. `north-node` → `NorthNode`, `house-1` → `House1`).

- Planets: `sun`, `moon`, `mercury`, `venus`, `mars`, `jupiter`, `saturn`, `uranus`, `neptune`, `pluto`
- Signs: `aries`, `taurus`, `gemini`, `cancer`, `leo`, `virgo`, `libra`, `scorpio`, `sagittarius`, `capricorn`, `aquarius`, `pisces`
- Aspects (by degree): `conjunction` (0°), `semi-sextile` (30°), `semi-square` (45°), `sextile` (60°), `quintile` (72°), `square` (90°), `trine` (120°), `sesqui-square` (135°), `biquintile` (144°), `quincunx` (150°), `opposition` (180°)
- Angles: `ascendant`, `descendant`, `medium-coeli`, `imum-coeli`, `ascendant-alt`, `descendant-alt`
- Houses: `house-1` … `house-12`
- Earth and Moon: `earth`, `north-node`, `south-node`, `lilith`
- Asteroids: `chiron`
- Lots: `fortune`

## SVG files

- [Raw SVGs](https://github.com/marcmarine/astroicons/tree/main/icons): One file per icon at `icons/<icon-name>.svg`, e.g. `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcmarine/astroicons/main/icons/sun.svg`
